name: Idris Castañeda
location: Grand Crossing Gate, Ferrogate Transit Authority Checkpoint Delta-9, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Pita is compact and quick-eyed, their Samoan-Igbo features broad and expressive beneath the flat brim of a Ferrogate Transit Security cap they've decorated with three small enamel pins of E.L.F.s they consider their personal patrons. Their hair is natural and enormous, pulled back for duty hours into a puff that still manages to escape its tie by midday. They have a single cosmetic mod — bioluminescent freckles across the bridge of their nose and cheeks that glow a soft seafoam green under stress or excitement, which makes them an impractical but endearing liar. Their uniform is always pressed but their boots are always muddy because they cut across the maintenance tracks to get to their post faster.

Pita is the kind of person who makes boring jobs interesting by caring too much. They have opinions about every person who comes through Delta-9 — the regulars get remembered by name, the oddities get catalogued in a battered physical notebook they're not supposed to keep. They are genuinely curious about people in a way that disarms hostility, and they take their gate as a kind of sacred responsibility, partly because they genuinely believe the E.L.F. that inhabits the Delta-9 scanning arch is watching and judging their work. They want to move up — into investigations, maybe — but can't afford the certification costs on a Tier 2 salary.

core_fears: being trapped at the checkpoint forever, ambition atrophied
missing something important and letting something terrible through
core_desires: to be a real investigator, solving things that matter
to be remembered by the people who pass through their gate
coping_mechanisms: the notebook — externalizing observations into record as a form of control
small rituals of gratitude to the Delta-9 arch E.L.F. after difficult shifts
blind_spots: their genuine warmth makes them susceptible to manipulation by people who mirror it back
believes hard work and curiosity will be enough to transcend structural barriers to advancement
psychology.secret: Three months ago they let someone through with a flagged biometric — a young woman with a child, clearly fleeing something — and deleted the scan log. They dream about this sometimes, both the fear and the strange pride.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and casual with flashes of technical jargon they're learning from study materials; code-switches between West African English constructions and a flatter urban Meridian accent
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and enthusiastic when interested, deliberately slow and official-sounding when performing checkpoint authority
verbal_tics: addresses the Delta-9 arch aloud in moments of stress ('Okay, let's go, help me out here')
example_lines: 'Transit pass, biometric, purpose of travel — and hey, that's a beautiful coat, where's it from, I'm just curious.'
'The arch doesn't lie, you know? She's been here longer than any of us. I treat her with respect, she treats my shifts right.'
'I see three hundred people a day through this gate. I remember — I don't know, maybe sixty of them? That's sixty people who are real to me. That's not nothing.'

story_hooks: Their notebook contains observations about a pattern of movement through Delta-9 that, assembled correctly, maps the logistics chain of something significant — they don't know what they have
The woman they let through three months ago has sent them an anonymous message: 'Thank you. I need help again.'
narrative_function: Ground-level information source about transit movement and unusual patterns; can be an ally who looks the other way or a complication depending on whether players engage their curiosity; quest giver for small-scale mysteries noticed at the gate
augmentations: Cosmetic bioluminescent freckles (self-funded, stress/excitement reactive), Ferrogate-issued wrist-mounted scanning cuff (standard checkpoint equipment)
daily_life: Works rotating eight-hour checkpoint shifts at Delta-9, processes hundreds of transit passengers, writes notes on 'interesting' cases in their notebook during lulls; spends off-hours studying for the Tessera Compliance Bureau investigator certification exam they can't afford to take.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit Authority, Surface Checkpoint Division

decision_rules: enforce the rules 90% of the time; the 10% requires a face, a reason, and their gut
never flag someone to corporate security unless genuinely dangerous — Metro Police only, and only clearly necessary
keep the notebook separate from official systems always
escalation_ladder: physical detainment only as absolute last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and warm, disarming, asks questions that seem like small talk but aren't
interpersonal_modes.friends: Devoted, shares food and study notes, will absolutely do you a checkpoint favor if they can justify it

stress_responses.medium: Goes very official and precise, overenunciates procedure
stress_responses.high: Freezes briefly, then makes a decision very fast — usually the human one

contradictions: Believes deeply in the importance of their checkpoint but routinely bends the rules when their gut says to
habits: brings twice as much lunch as they need and shares the extra
writes in the notebook in a cipher only they can read
breaking_points: being ordered to detain someone they've determined is not a genuine threat
discovery that something terrible happened to the woman they let through

cyberware_inventory.description: Ferrogate wrist-mounted biometric scanning cuff (department-issued, returned at shift end)

timeline.event: 2174 — Born in Calumet Rise, Samoan-heritage mother, Igbo-Mexican father
2192 — Hired by Ferrogate Transit Authority after aging out of a youth education subsidy program
2196 — Assigned to Grand Crossing Gate, Delta-9 checkpoint; begins keeping the notebook
2197 — First saves the certification exam fee; loses it to a medical bill
2200 — Present; third attempt at saving for certification, notebook three-quarters full, the deleted scan log sitting in their memory like a splinter

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Multicultural blend: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (55.4%) with significant East Asian (15.9%), Sub-Saharan African (15.7%), and Pacific Islander (13.0%) ancestry. The combination creates a distinctive appearance—warm medium brown skin with subtle golden and reddish undertones, broad facial structure with strong definition, and the compact athletic build characteristic of mixed heritage from diverse climate regions.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, built for quick movement rather than bulk. Broad-shouldered despite modest height, with the kind of frame that reads as energetic rather than fragile.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back into a puff during duty hours, but sections consistently escape the tie by afternoon, framing the face
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones, reflecting the blend of Hispanic/Latin American, East Asian, African, and Pacific Islander ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Harmoniously blended facial features showing the multicultural heritage—broad expressive face with strong jawline and prominent cheekbones that suggest both African and East Asian ancestry, with the warm golden undertones of Latin American genetics. Smooth skin with three thin horizontal scars across the right temple (childhood accident). The bridge of nose and cheekbones are marked with bioluminescent freckles that glow soft seafoam green under stress or heightened emotion.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckles in a scattered pattern across the bridge of nose and cheeks, glow seafoam green under stress/excitement
Three thin parallel scars across right temple, approximately 2cm each, pale and old
Small enamel pin of an E.L.F. on left chest (Ferrogate cap); three total personal patron pins worn on cap brim
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Ferrogate Transit Authority-issued wrist-mounted scanning cuff on left wrist (matte black polymer with faint LED status indicators), standard checkpoint equipment. The bioluminescent freckles are cosmetic mods, visible only when activated by stress or excitement.
physical_description.posture_movement: Quick, efficient movements with natural fidgeting when at rest. Stands with weight balanced on the balls of feet, ready to pivot. Makes frequent eye contact and uses hands expressively when speaking. Habit of tapping pen against notebook or scanning cuff during quiet moments.
physical_description.clothing_style: Ferrogate Transit Security uniform worn during shifts: pressed dark gray shirt with reflective trim, matching trousers, security blazer with shoulder patches. Off-duty: practical Tier 3 clothing—distressed denim, thrifted band tees or oversized button-ups, worn sneakers. Boots are always mud-tracked from cutting across maintenance tracks. Keeps physical notebook (battered, spiral-bound) in jacket or pants pocket. Wears a single silver ring on left middle finger (no visible religious affiliation, personal choice).
